text.ms:
1. Peraturan-Peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2021.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2021

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu bilion

satu ratus lima juta lima ratus lima puluh dua ribu ringgit (RM1,105,552,000) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan

Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2021 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 253,974,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 288,090,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 83,218,000

Perbelanjaan lain 136,311,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 343,959,000

JUMLAH 1,105,552,000

Dibuat 3 Jun 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXIII]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees'Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2021.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2021

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one billion one hundred and five million five

hundred and fifty-two thousand ringgit (RM1,105,552,000) from the

Social Security Fund for the expenditure on administration of the Scheme of

Social Security for the year 2021 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified

in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 253,974,000

Supplies and services 288,090,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 83,218,000

Other expenditures 136,311,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 343,959,000

TOTAL 1,105,552,000

Made 3 June 2021

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXIII]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
